messages:
lucy: Hey folks — quick copy pass for the deployment fallback banner that appears when we route to a slower/cheaper model variant. Want tone help: clear, not scary, and actionable. Drafts below.

lucy: Draft A (concise): 
`Using a fallback model due to capacity. Responses may be slower or slightly different. Learn more`

lucy: Draft B (reassuring): 
`We’re using an alternate model to keep requests working. You may notice small differences in responses. Check details or retry.`

lucy: Draft C (action-first): 
`Fallback active: requests routed to an alternate model. View details · Retry · Contact support`

raj: thanks — I like B for product. Clear and less scary. Suggest replacing "small differences" with "minor quality differences" so it's precise.

sam: from infra: we also want the banner to indicate whether fallback is temporary vs persisted (e.g., due to capacity spike vs pinned policy). Can we add a tiny status token? like `Temporary` or `Pinned`?

marta: usability note: avoid verbs like "retry" without context. If retry just resends the request it could cost tokens again. Suggest `Request again` vs `Retry`? Or show a tooltip that explains cost.

jordan: accessibility nits: make sure the banner has role="status" and an associated aria-describedby for the details link. Also the contrast on the status token needs >=4.5:1.

lucy: good points. New combined copy attempt: 
`Fallback active (Temporary): We’re using an alternate model to keep your requests running. You may notice minor quality differences or slightly higher latency. View details · Request again`

raj: quick wording nit: "slightly higher latency" might be redundant with "keep requests running". Maybe "you may notice minor quality or latency differences."

sam: Also we should avoid promising "running" if a queued drop happens. Maybe say "to keep requests operating" feels odd. Could be: "to maintain availability."

marta: prefer short sentence pattern. How about: 
`Fallback active (Temporary). An alternate model is being used to maintain availability. You may notice minor quality or latency differences. View details · Request again`

lucy: I like that. Two quick UX Qs: 1) Should we show the model name in the details pane only (privacy/abbrev concerns)? 2) CTA order: `View details` first or `Request again` first?

sam: model name in details only. We often mask full internal variant names in the banner. CTA order: put info first, action second — reduces accidental retries.

raj: agree. Also add a short hover tooltip on `Request again` that says "This will resend the request and may incur additional cost."

jordan: Accessibility: ensure links are keyboard focusable, and tooltip text is available on focus as aria-describedby. Also confirm banner is dismissible and dismissal persists for current session so screen reader users don't get repeated announcements.

lucy: Updated final copy (for engineering): 
`Fallback active (Temporary). An alternate model is being used to maintain availability. You may notice minor quality or latency differences. View details · Request again`

lucy: Implementation notes for eng: 
- show status token (`Temporary` | `Pinned`) with 4.5:1 contrast
- `View details` opens panel with reasons + model variant (name masked) + timestamp
- `Request again` triggers a confirm tooltip: "This will resend your request and may incur additional cost."
- banner role=status, dismissible for session, aria-describedby pointed to details link

sam: looks good. small ask: add a machine-readable flag in the payload `fallback.active=true|false` so SDKs can surface custom UI.

lucy: will add to spec. @deploy-bot any thoughts for rollout?

deploy-bot: reminder: when you ship copy changes, include translation keys and a fallback english string. Also schedule a canary deploy to eng-sre before global rollout.

marta: last UX ask: add a short microcopy for the details panel header: `Fallback details` -> maybe `Why this fallback happened`? prefer the latter for clarity.

lucy: finalized: header = `Why this fallback happened`. Thanks everyone — I'll update figma and the copy doc, add the accessibility checklist, and drop the spec into the PR."
